notes: Triple-homonym consonant risk: צָלַל also covers H6749 ("tumble down, sink") and H6751 ("shade, grow dark"), both unrelated and not yet in this dataset. Every extracted form here was confirmed lemma-tagged H6750 specifically, with no cross-contamination -- flagged for anyone adding either of the other two later.

Hiphil ("tingle", 1Sam.3.11, תְּצִלֶּינָה) is attested but wasn't part of the original request -- added per the full-stem-coverage check; it carries the same sense as the requested qal, just in a different stem.

Retroactively renamed from the plain key "צלל" to "צלל¹" when H6751 ("grow dark; shade") was added to the dataset as "צלל²" -- the true homograph anticipated above -- per the root-key superscript convention (lower Strong's number gets ¹). H6749 remains unadded and will need its own superscript (³) whenever it's added.
